messages.subject: Mpiprofiler Project: Participation request
parts:
I am a peruvian Computer Science Phd. student at the University of Campinas,Brazil and I am very interested in the project "Profiling Tools for Parallel Computing with R". I have a little experience with parallel computing using openmpi and during my master research, I have used the R software to analise intrachip traffic statistical behaviour. I feel capable to support this project to retribute the open-source community.
I have complete the Tests proposed on the Mpiprofiler Ideas site. On the attachment are the resultant files: The fpmpi output provided by the profiler, a fibonacci.c which calculates the first n fibonacci numbers where n is the input and which was later build in the R shared library  with R CMD SHLIB fibonacci.c. Also includes a fibo_test.R file containing the R script to implement a function named fibonacci2.

Best regards,
Jorge Gonzalez
